name: importance
description: How important one gated item is to this reader right now, to pick the few a sweep presents

importance.instructions: How important is the item in `title` and `excerpt` for this reader right now? Weights run from 0.1 to 2 with 1 as neutral: a higher `topic_weight` (the weight of `topic` among `topic_keywords`) and a higher `source_weight` mean the reader cares more. Newer `published_at` beats older. `taste_examples` lists items the reader liked or disliked.
